description: An object `iter()` accepts; a container returns a new iterator on every call, so it can be looped again.
An object with `__next__` and an `__iter__` that returns itself; it remembers a position and supports one pass.
The exception `__next__` raises when an iterator is exhausted; `for` loops and `list()` catch it as the end.
The iterator returned by calling a function that contains `yield`; its frame pauses at each `yield`.
Producing each item only when the consumer asks for it, so unused items are never computed or read.
